text: Ｌボタンか　Ｒボタンで　みられます

structure.jp: Ｌボタンか　Ｒボタンで
structure.en: with the L Button or the R Button

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb here means 'can do it'. みられます = 'you can see it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows that it is the tool you use to do something. Ｒボタンで = 'with the R Button'.

patterns.name: 〜か〜
patterns.explanation: か between two things means 'or'. Ｌボタンか　Ｒボタン = 'the L Button or the R Button'.
